work.title: Freeze one ingress
work.objective: Use one stable HTTPS/WSS public origin for the Pocket browser → VPS path and keep the application listener loopback-only.
inspect: VPS reverse-proxy/tunnel/public-url configuration through authenticated private access
Current public HTTPS and WSS routing
acceptance: runtime-config, CSP, Server.PublicUrl and ingress configuration resolve to the same stable origin
HTTPS /api/health succeeds through that origin
WSS upgrade succeeds through that origin
no second public application port is required
doNot: Do not publish private VPS repository names, paths, credentials or machine configuration in public Project Brain.
Do not open another raw VPS application port.
Do not use a rotating quick-tunnel URL as production runtime-config.

work.title: Close server contract parity
work.objective: Promote the canonical server contract required by the merged Pocket/Pirate client.
acceptance: canonical server source exposes the required routes/operations
exact-head contract tests are SAT
client and server operation names/payload semantics match
doNot: Do not treat client CI as proof of server endpoint support.

work.title: Pin one Pirate worker artifact
work.objective: Build and deploy the VPS Pirate worker from the exact reviewed Pirate source used by the shipped release.
acceptance: release manifest pins Pirate source SHA
worker artifacts have recorded SHA-256
CI rejects stale or mismatched worker source
doNot: Do not infer worker parity from repository branch names or commit messages.

work.title: Prove runtime readiness
work.objective: Prove the running VPS process has the reviewed worker bound and the public origin is ready for browser traffic.
acceptance: read-only readiness reports worker contract/version/hash without secrets
HTTPS health/version SAT from public origin
CORS preflight SAT
WSS upgrade/auth readiness SAT
doNot: Do not expose credentials or machine paths from readiness endpoints.

work.title: Run real browser QA
work.objective: Complete one QA-only authenticated browser transaction across Firebase launcher → Pocket → VPS → Pirate gameplay.
acceptance: QA login and launch-ticket issue/redeem SAT
authenticated WSS SAT
Pirate state GET SAT
vitals input POST SAT
one idempotent Pirate operation SAT
doNot: Do not enable broad production player/economy writes only to diagnose connectivity.

work.title: Promote live-host authority
work.objective: Update Project Brain only after P0-P4 have deterministic SAT evidence.
acceptance: P0-P4 are SAT with evidence
live-host integration status is updated from BLOCKED/UNKNOWN
new checkpoint and tests preserve UNKNOWN ≠ PASS
doNot: Do not promote from documentation-only or health-only proof.
